item.title: Inniku Kaizou Ranbu ~Kurutta Shinka no Michibiki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Märchen Dream
  • 発売日: 2009-08-03
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫肉改造乱舞 ～狂った進化の導き～
  • 英語名: Inniku Kaizou Ranbu Kurutta Shinka no Michibiki

あらすじ

Manya is taken prisoner in King Leo’s castle and used as material for an evolution experiment using the “hidden treasure” of Balzac, the avenging enemy.

Manya is subjected to obscene “body modification” and humiliation in the name of “adjustment”.

And what fate awaits her…

The player manipulates Balzac to create the “mother body that produces the ultimate creature.
